children: Londax Corp. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $28.3K and a net loss of $37.3K, with diluted EPS of $(0.02), reflecting a year-over-year decline as the company shifted its revenue recognition to ratable subscription sales.
Revenue was $28.3K for FY2026, down from $66.4K in FY2025; YoY change (57.3%).
Net income was a loss of $37.3K for FY2026, compared with a loss of $1.2K in FY2025 (loss widened).
Diluted EPS was $(0.02) for FY2026, compared with $(0.00) for FY2025.
Revenue decline driven by a shift away from one-time service sales toward ratable annual subscriptions, reducing near-term cash receipts but intended to build recurring revenue.
Cost of sales fell to $0 for the year, increasing the emphasis on recurring software offerings for gross profit.
Professional fees rose materially as the company incurred costs related to being public (DTC, audit, filing, transfer), while overall G&A decreased.
Post-year-end, management pivoted strategy toward AI and digital infrastructure to scale product capabilities; execution of this plan will require additional capital.
